results.title: Officer Grey
results.overview: Found Footage Horror Film  Produced by Impound Comics  Synopsis:  Officer Sarah Grey is known for killing five fellow police officers before taking her own life. This heinous act leaves the community with more questions than answers. Now, her body camera footage is finally being released, providing the public with much needed answers!  Directed & Written By: Brent Trayce Sands  DP: Andrew Johnston  Starring: Unissa Cruse, Derek Casper & Orianna Fancher

results.title: Pangea
results.overview: Rita spends her last day in the city trying to resurrect the artist her ex-lover used to be.

results.title: Magic Bibs
results.overview: The ambitious captain of a failing social netball team attempts to fix their losing streak with a spell, but it may cost the team their friendship.

results.title: Amira's Children
results.overview: This 10- year documentary follows the Alhariri family, as they integrate into Czech society, despite their different faith, culture, and traditions. While Amira becomes the cultural anchor of the family, her husband, Abdul, works hard in a small kebab shop. Their eldest son, Kenan, is scarred by his experiences of war, and struggles to find new values. His younger brother, Montaser, on the other hand, is clear about his inherited values. Son Adnan and daughter Zaina fit in perfectly with their Czech classmates from the first grade, while the youngest children, Hamud and Kamar, still have time to find their way. Amira knows what life in Europe has to offer, but she never stops believing in a return to her homeland.

results.title: COWBOYS: A Show by Business Casual
results.original_title: COWBOYS: A Show by Business Casual
results.overview: COWBOYS is a slapstick comedy telling the story of a gunslinging cowboy seeking revenge on the three men who killed his family. He must assemble a posse and set out on the journey of a lifetime. Along the way, the group encounter gold miners, snake oil salesman, and just about every Western trope you could think of.

results.title: Healing Lands
results.overview: In Labrador, Moïra Ashini meets Sheshatshius chief who shares his concerns about the health of his people. She meets several Innu who are camping at the Gull Island gathering to further their healing process. There she befriends Julie-Ann who is enrolled in the Christian Youth Camp detox program. This young mothers goal is to heal in order to regain custody of her two-year-old daughter.

results.title: Therachaapa
results.overview: After a devastating cyclone displaces a fishing community, they seek refuge only to fall under the control of ruthless drug dealers. Amid the turmoil, a carefree young fisherman is forced to grow up after a personal tragedy, torn between love and his duty to protect his people, as he rises to stand against oppression.

results.title: Lajf
results.overview: At a small bus station in an anonymous town, five strangers meet. Each has their own reasons for no longer enjoying life and wanting to end it, but none of them has the courage to do it alone.

results.title: The Memory Faded.
results.overview: Seong-beom, a tutoring teacher, visits his old middle school to retrieve a graduation certificate required by his academy director — only to discover that his student record no longer exists in the system. With the help of So-eun, a former classmate now teaching at the school, he begins to trace the missing files. In doing so, he finds that another name has also been erased: Shim Won-mo, a friend from middle school. Won-mo was two years older than the rest of his class, adopted, and always on the margins — a boy who eventually dropped out after running away from home more than once. Seong-beom had watched Won-mo drift and struggle, yet never reached out. Now, after all these years, news arrives that Won-mo has taken his own life.

results.title: Um Tio Quase Perfeito 3
results.overview: Uncle Tony feels increasingly abandoned by his nephews, who have grown up and become independent. Then, one day, a baby is left on his doorstep. Uncertain of what to do, he calls on them, and together they hatch wild schemes to find the child's parents.

results.title: Liv's Last Ride
results.overview: When an unexpected visitor disrupts a bachelorette party at a secluded cabin, the bridal party must bury old grudges and their shared dark history in order to survive the night.

results.title: Independence Today
results.overview: An in depth look at ‘FRAPP’, a collective of young Senegalese activists in Dakar, as the country prepares for its most decisive presidential election since independence in 1960. How far are they prepared to go to succeed in their struggle?

results.title: Calabash
results.overview: When two families with distinct traditions, expectations, and unspoken agendas come together for a celebration meant to unite them, anxiety-fueled scenarios quickly spiral.

results.title: Bled Dry: The Legacy of the Tri-State Wrestling Alliance
results.original_title: Bled Dry: The Legacy of the Tri-State Wrestling Alliance
results.overview: For the first time ever – the true story of the Tri-State Wrestling Alliance, will be told. By the people who lived it. Find out how it all started, how it changed the industry forever, and how the reunion show all went down!

results.title: Healthy
results.overview: Oleg, who is bent on health, faces a deadly threat which turns his system of values upside down.

results.title: The Taste of Your Scales
results.overview: Eager to prove himself to his father, Jasmin finally gets the chance to accompany him to the fish factory he runs. But when an emergency call brings them there one evening, a journey through its labyrinthine corridors exposes a disturbing reality that shatters everything Jasmin believed about his father and his future.

results.title: Chirkut
results.overview: Based on a real-life incident at Rajshahi University in the 1990s, the film portrays campus life, friendship, romance, and the experiences of students during that era.

results.title: Toutes Directions
results.overview: When a 71-year-old regional taxi driver hears that he is losing his beloved job, he decides to take a different turn with his worn-out van full of regular passengers. The journey that follows, in which no passenger is left untouched, turns out to be exactly what he needs to start the rest of his life.

results.title: Red Ape
results.overview: There is a Red Ape in the woods. There is darkness everywhere.
